name: onegate
description: Debug OneGate DApps through a Skills-only local runtime with a persistent development identity and a document-start NEP-21 Browser Mock.

interface.longDescription: Use the bundled Skill and local JSON CLI to open a DApp at its original URL, inject a OneGate-compatible NEP-21 provider before page scripts, reuse one persistent development account for real signatures, and inspect browser state, console output, screenshots, and dAPI traces. Browser Mock is the currently implemented debugging target.
defaultPrompt: Open my DApp with the OneGate Browser Mock and inspect its dAPI calls.
Test this DApp's OneGate signing flow with the persistent development account.
Run this DApp with a simulated OneGate transaction profile.
